{{c|{{x-larger|OF IESVS CHRIST ACCOR-}}}}
{{c|{{larger|DING TO MATTHEVV.}}}}

{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text={{sc|The first}} part of this Goſpel, of the Infancie of our Sauiour Chriſt.}}{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. I.}}}}}}

{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 12. 22. 2. Reg. 7. Pſal. 131.''}}{{c|''The pedegree of Iesus, to shew that he is Christ, promised to * Abraham and * Dauid. 18. That he was conceiued and borne of a Virgin, as Esay prophecied of him.''}} {{verse|chapter=1|verse=1}}{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=This Gospel is most solemly sung in holy Church at Mattins vpō Christmas day. As also it is the Gospel of the ''Cōception'' and ''Natiuitie'' of our B. Lady: because here is declared the pedegree of her also.}}THE booke of the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 3, 31.''}}* generation of IESVS Christ, the sonne of Dauid, the sonne of Abraham.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=2}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 21. 25. 29. 38.''}}* Abraham begat Isaac, And Isaac begat Iacob. And Iacob begat Iudas and his brethren: {{verse|chapter=1|verse=3}}† And Iudas begat Phares and Zaram of ‖ Thamar. {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1 Par. 2, 5. Ruth. 4, 18.''}}* And Phares begat Esron. And Esron begat Aram. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=4}}† And Aram begat Aminadab. And Aminadab begat Naasson. And Naasson begat Salmon. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=5}}† And Salmon begat Booz of Raab. And Booz begat Obed of Ruth. And Obed begat Iesse. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=6}}† And Iesse begat Dauid the King.

And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''2 Re. 12, 24.''}}* Dauid the King begat Salomon of her that was the vvife of Vrias. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=7}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1 Par. 3, 10.''}}* Salomon begat Roboam. And Roboam begat Abia. And Abia begat Asa. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=8}}† And Asa begat Iosaphat. And Iosaphat begat Ioram. And Ioram begat Ozias. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=9}}† And Ozias begat Ioatham. And Ioatham begat Achaz. And Achaz begat Ezechias. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=10}}† And Ezechias begat Manasses. And Manasses begat Amon. And Amon begat Iosias. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=11}}† And Iosias begat Iechonias & his brethren {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''4 Reg. 24. 2. Par. 36.''}}* in the Transmigration of Babylon.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=12}}† And after the Transmigration of Babylon, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1 Par. 3.''}}* Iechonias begat Salathiel. {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1 Esd. 3.''}}* And Salathiel begat Zorobabel. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=13}}† And Zorobabel begat Abiud. And Abiud begat Eliacim. And Eliacim begat Azor. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=14}}† And Azor begat Sadoc. And Sadoc begat Achim. And Achim begat Eliud. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=15}}† And Eliud begat Eleazar. And Eleazar begat Mathan. And Mathan begat Iacob. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=16}}† And Iacob<noinclude>{{rh||A ij|begat}}</noinclude>
